row.evidence: Devin's SCIM docs say "Devin Enterprise supports SCIM 2.0 for automatic user and group provisioning", and the pricing page lists SAML/OIDC SSO only under Enterprise ("Let's talk"), above Teams at $40/mo per full seat.
row.notes: New row. Devin by Cognition. Self-serve plans are Free, Pro ($20/mo) and Max ($200/mo), which are single-user, and Teams ($40/mo per full seat, free flex seats, $80/mo minimum, up to 200 users); prices are monthly, no annual price is shown. SAML/OIDC SSO and SCIM 2.0 are Enterprise-only (Contact Sales); the pricing page lists SSO but not SCIM, so the SCIM gate comes from the docs. SCIM: bearer token generated in Settings > Enterprise > Membership, base URL ending /scim/v2, Users create/read/list/update/deactivate/delete and Groups create/read/list/update/delete; Okta via the generic 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token)' and Entra via a non-gallery app (no Devin catalogue apps). Deactivation removes enterprise membership; existing sessions stay active until they expire. SSO alone does JIT provisioning with no automated deprovisioning. Enterprise API v3 manages users, org memberships, roles, IdP groups and audit logs (Enterprise only, so api_tax true); the org-level user list endpoints are read-only beta.

plans.name: Teams
plans.price_text: $80/month for team plan + $40/mo per full dev seat
plans.notes: Up to 200 users; flex seats free and draw on shared credits. Organization API (sessions etc.) available, but user management is in the Enterprise API.

scim.base_url: SCIM base URL shown in Settings > Enterprise > Membership (ends in /scim/v2)

auth.token_source: Settings > Enterprise > Membership > Members tab > User and IdP group provisioning > SCIM bearer token > Generate token

operations.notes: Docs say "update" without naming PUT or PATCH.

deprovision.notes: Deactivation removes enterprise membership immediately; reassigning restores it. Existing sessions remain active until they expire.

roles.how: Group-to-role mapping: SCIM groups appear as IdP groups mapped to enterprise roles and org access in Settings > Enterprise > Membership > Groups (IdP); new users get the default Enterprise Member role.

limitations.text: userName must be the email address and match the provisioned work email.
JIT provisioning should be off while SCIM is used, or groups re-sync on every login.
Okta uses the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App and Entra a non-gallery app; no Devin catalogue apps.

auth.notes: Service-user API keys or personal access tokens (cog_ prefix) as Bearer tokens; RBAC permissions instead of scopes.

endpoints.purpose: Get user (direct and IdP-group role assignments)

rate_limits.text: HTTP 429 when the rate limit is exceeded; limits not published.

okta.notes: No Devin app in the OIN (search "devin" returns nothing). Devin docs use the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token) and a custom OIDC app for SSO.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial (devin-tutorial 404). Devin docs use a non-gallery enterprise app for SCIM.

open_questions: Whether SCIM deactivation frees a paid seat is not documented.
SCIM token expiry is not documented (rotate/revoke only).
Devin API rate limits are not published.
